target.what: Number of bottles of Zhenjiang Hengshun (恒顺) vinegar (all bottled vinegar types combined, including aromatic/sharp vinegar 香醋 and other bottled vinegar products) sold by Jiangsu Hengshun Group / Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co. into the United States market, counted as bottles (retail units) delivered/
target.publisher: None official; Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co., Ltd. (600305.SH) annual report and China customs export statistics are the closest reporting sources
target.cadence: Annual (company annual report); monthly/quarterly (China customs HS-code export data)
target.caveats: Working interpretation: calendar year 2024 (most recent completed full year before the 2026-10-18 cutoff), bottles sold into the US (export shipments to US, not US retail sell-through). Hengshun does not publish US-specific bottle counts; the figure must be estimated. Alternatives: (a) export volume

candidates.hypothesis: Hengshun's annual report discloses total revenue, export/overseas revenue, and sometimes export volume; overseas revenue multiplied by a US share of exports gives a route to US sales value, then divided by average bottle price gives bottle count. Direction: higher overseas revenue and higher US share imply more bottles.

kept.applies_when: Converts total US-bound Chinese vinegar volume into Hengshun-attributable volume.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun's share of Chinese vinegar exports to the US is below 10% or above 45%.

kept.name: Average bottle fill for Hengshun bottled vinegar sold in the US
kept.rationale: Export bottles are commonly 500-550 ml (p49); US retail also carries 750 ml-1 L formats, so a mean near 0.5 L with a wide range is reasonable.
kept.applies_when: Converts litres of Hengshun US-bound vinegar into retail bottle units.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that US-bound Hengshun bottles are predominantly much smaller or larger than 0.35-0.75 L.

kept.name: US share of China vinegar export volume, 2024
kept.rationale: US share of China vinegar export volume was 11.35% (2020-2022, p12) and 10-14% by value 2017-2021 (p78-p79); carrying ~11% into 2024 with a modest range is consistent with the stable historical share.
kept.applies_when: Applied to 2024 total China vinegar export volume (p26) to get US-bound litres.
kept.falsified_by: 2024 customs data showing US share outside 8-15%.

kept.name: Zhenjiang-type share of US-bound Chinese vinegar
kept.rationale: p59 shows the US takes 31% of Zhenjiang vinegar exports; conversely Zhenjiang aromatic vinegar is a major but not exclusive component of Chinese vinegar shipped to the US, so 15-50% of US-bound Chinese vinegar being Zhenjiang-type is plausible.
kept.applies_when: Used with p26 and a3 to estimate Zhenjiang-type US-bound volume, then scaled by Hengshun's share of Zhenjiang exports.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Zhenjiang-type vinegar is a much smaller or larger fraction of US-bound Chinese vinegar.

kept.name: Hengshun share of Zhenjiang-type vinegar exports
kept.rationale: Hengshun is the flagship Zhenjiang vinegar enterprise and by far the largest exporter of the style; a majority-to-plurality share of Zhenjiang-type exports is plausible, tempered by many smaller registered producers.
kept.applies_when: Converts Zhenjiang-type US-bound volume into Hengshun-attributable volume.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun holds well under 30% or over 70% of Zhenjiang vinegar exports.

kept.name: US share of Hengshun exports
